p: Your coding agents work in shells on real machines. Tabs puts every one of those shells in front of you — split, tiled, and reachable from anywhere you can open a browser.

h2: Link a machine, and it appears here

p: Run hanzo link on a laptop, a workstation, a GPU box — anything with a shell. The machine keeps the connection, and nothing is exposed to the network it sits on. Open Tabs and the shells are there.
